panels.description: A missing section of conduit walkway opens above the shallow channel. Alex, Ada and B11 stop at the edge; leave upper tunnel space.
Ada throws a rope around a structural brace and tests the span. Keep her planted stance and the anchor clear.
Ada crosses the gap first using the rope while Alex waits with B11 and TJ behind her. Leave upper space for her warning.
The lower walkway tears loose and disappears beneath the rising water after the group crosses. Keep the destruction contained and leave upper darkness.
